blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A 78-year-old man was killed after a tree branch fell on him in a remote area of Barangay Talisay, Daanbantayan, Cebu, on Tuesday afternoon, September 29. The victim was identified as alias “Michael,” 78, married, and a resident of Sitio Dapdap in the said barangay. The Daanbantayan Municipal Police Station received a report regarding a lifeless body found in an isolated area.
